events.evidence: The Shanghai stock market falls 30% over the past three weeks as 1,400 companies, or more than half listed, file for a trading halt in an attempt to prevent further losses
The New York Stock Exchange stops trading for nearly four hours due to a technical error
The British bank Barclays fires Chief Executive Antony Jenkins for his failure to reduce head count and the pace of cost cutting

label.note: Shanghai collapse and mass trading halts dominate; NYSE technical halt and Barclays CEO exit add risk-off.
